messages:
release-manager: FYI RC-4 to main -> eu-canary blocked by DeployBot SBOM policy check. flag: libfastcache@2.1.8 license=UNKNOWN. Can we triage quickly?

deploybot: [system] sbom_scan: FAIL; policy=sbom-license; matched=1; pkg=libfastcache@2.1.8; evidence=https://scans.internal/s/4918273340

alex: Is that transitive via renderer or the base image?

jamie: transitive in renderer's package-lock, pulled in by render-worker@1.5.0. I can check which build added it.

sre-oncall: If we stall global, customer impact could be large. Can we carve out eu-canary only and continue global?

release-manager: Options: 1) carveout EU canary (fast) 2) pin renderer to a hotfix image that drops the dep (medium) 3) rollback RC-4 (slow). I propose carveout + hotfix roll forward if legal approves. Need a release-note line and compliance log.

legal: Quick read — UNKNOWN license is a red flag. If libfastcache is not redistributed (only runtime) we might be OK, but need SBOM evidence and an audit ticket. Share SBOM link.

jamie: SBOM snippet ->
```
- name: libfastcache
  version: 2.1.8
  license: UNKNOWN
  path: /node_modules/renderer/node_modules/libfastcache
```

alex: To pin to hotfix we can do: `deployctl set-image renderer:2.3.4-hotfix --force` (build queued). That will remove the transitive dep.

deploybot: carveout helper: `deploybot carveout --service renderer --regions eu-west-1 --reason "sbom-flag libfastcache"`

release-manager: jamie + alex can you coordinate carveout now? I'll update release notes to note an EU canary carveout due to SBOM variance and mark RC-4 partial. Legal, can you sign off on carveout while you review the license?

legal: Signed off to carve out EU canary only for now while we open a compliance ticket. Please include SBOM link and the build id. I'll take ownership of the ticket.

sre-oncall: I'll watch error budget and latency; creating a monitor for renderer eu-canary for 30m.

jamie: pushing hotfix branch that removes libfastcache, CI passing, ETA ~18m to image available.

alex: After image is ready we'll roll renderer:2.3.4-hotfix into eu-canary; global will wait until legal clears.

release-manager: Applying carveout now.

alex: `deploybot carveout` command executed at 4918273500

deploybot: [system] carveout applied; service=renderer; regions=[eu-west-1]; actor=alex; time=4918273500; reason=sbom-flag

release-manager: Carveout successful. Marking RC-4 as "partial-deployed (EU carveout)" and updating release notes. Opening compliance ticket and assigning to legal.

jamie: hotfix image pushed at 4918273580, ready for canary replace once legal gives final OK.

legal: I've created ticket COMP-2026-412 with the SBOM link and initial assessment. Will update with final decision within the change window.

sre-oncall: Monitoring active, no regression seen in remaining canaries.

release-manager: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now, will post final roll-forward/rollback decision after legal.
